name: SN 2004gk field (Hubble)
blurb: A field around SN 2004gk, a hydrogen-poor supernova, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2004gkfield-hubble
story: The site of SN 2004gk, a Type Ic supernova, where a massive star stripped of its hydrogen exploded. Hubble returned to take a census of the bright, massive stars around the site.

claims.text: SN 2004gk is a Type Ic supernova
Hubble program 14762 imaged massive star populations at the sites of hydrogen-poor supernovae, including SN2004GK
